title: Digital Marketing Manager
description:
JD / Key Responsibilities / KRAs Lead and manage digital marketing and social media promotions for advertiser campaigns, events, and special initiatives. Plan and execute paid media campaigns across platforms including Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, and LinkedIn to maximize campaign reach and engagement. Develop platform-wise digital campaign strategies for events and initiatives covering pre-event, during-event, and post-event promotion. Conceptualize digital solutions as a support to print advertising including social media promotions, video campaigns, branded content, and podcast integrations for clients so as to increase the response of the campaign. Drive lead generation and registration campaigns to increase participation in initiatives, events, and advertiser promotions. Identify and collaborate with relevant influencers and digital creators to expand campaign reach and brand visibility. Implement audience targeting strategies including geo-targeting, demographic segmentation, and interest-based targeting to improve campaign effectiveness. Plan content amplification strategies including boosting key creatives, reels, announcement posts, and high-performing content. Leverage trend-based digital formats such as reels, shorts, and viral content styles to increase engagement and visibility. Build collaborations with relevant social media pages, communities, and digital platforms to expand promotional reach. Conduct real-time campaign monitoring and optimization to ensure improved performance during active campaigns. Track and analyze campaign performance metrics including reach, impressions, CTR, engagement, and conversions. Prepare weekly and campaign-level performance reports with insights and improvement recommendations. Support sales teams with digital campaign ideas, proposals, and presentations for key advertisers. Coordinating with Digital / Social media agencies for routine promotions, review and payments.

Key Skills: Campaigns,SEO,Google Ads,Facebook Ads,Google AdWords,Instagram Ads,Facebook,AdWords

title: Social Media Marketing Intern
description: Key Responsibilities 1. Social Media Management: Assist in managing social media platforms such as Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, and other relevant channels. 2. Content Creation: Create engaging posts, captions, stories, reels, and other content in line with the brand's objectives. 3. Content Planning: Help prepare and maintain a social media content calendar to ensure regular and timely posting. 4. Creative Coordination: Coordinate with the design and marketing teams to develop creatives, graphics, videos, and promotional materials. 5. Trend Analysis: Stay updated on the latest social media trends, hashtags, trending topics, and digital marketing practices. 6. Audience Engagement: Monitor comments, messages, and audience interactions to support engagement and maintain a positive brand image. 7. Campaign Support: Assist in planning and executing social media campaigns for brand awareness, promotions, and audience growth. 8. Performance Tracking: Monitor post engagement, reach, impressions, followers, and other key performance indicators (KPIs). 9. Competitor Analysis: Research competitors' social media activities, content strategies, and engagement practices to identify improvement opportunities. 10. Reporting: Prepare basic weekly or monthly reports on social media performance and suggest ideas to improve engagement and reach. 11. Content Research: Research relevant topics, audience interests, and industry updates to develop fresh and engaging content ideas. 12. Team Coordination: Work closely with the marketing team to ensure content aligns with brand guidelines, campaign objectives, and communication standards.
